fee_check.rule: per-order fee = ceil(0.07 x C x p x (1-p), $0.0001); average_fee_paid = fee / C truncated to 4 dp

kalshi_check.note: fees = sum(count x average_fee_paid); average_fee_paid is a 4-dp per-contract average, so the sum can differ from Kalshi's cent figure by a fraction of a cent

pending_detail.note: protected prop still unsettled; its regular twin is settled. Protection pays the pre-kickoff fair price only if the player played in the 1st half but no snap after it, which market data cannot confirm

B_decomposition.identity: total = entry_edge + exit_edge - fees + market_moves; market_moves = sum over sells of n*fair_exit + open n*settle - sum over buys of n*fair_entry
B_decomposition.exit_rule_note: a rule exit needs bid - fee >= fair + 0.5c after a buy at ask with fair >= ask + fee + 1c, so unless the thin bid rallies above the entry ask, an exit can only fire after the fair has fallen by at least the spread + both fees + 1.5c: positive entry and exit edges with negative market moves are partly built into the rules

C_markouts.method: state at time t = close of the latest 1-min candle that ended at or before t (carried forward; no look-ahead). +0 is therefore up to 59 s older than the fill. Outcome terms: NO prices are 1 - YES. mid_markout averages use only thin mids with spread <= 10c. 'label' (primary) compares the entry snapshot -- the preflight fair and the ask paid -- with the candle fair and thin ask at +k: ask up >= 1c = thin moved toward fair, fair down >= 1c = fair moved toward thin, both >= 1c in the same direction = game event. 'label_candle_baseline' does the same from the +0 candle (thin mid, or ask when the mid is unusable). In the protected-prop books the ask jumps between sparse resting orders, so their thin moves are noisy.

budget_capped_hindsight.note: hindsight on one game, ex-fee unless stated; outcomes are correlated (same game, same players)

D_funnel.hold_listing_vs_book_note: book EV - listing EV = price part + fair part (outcome terms). Negative price part = the book's price was worse than the listing's; negative fair part = the book-based fair was lower than the listing-based fair.

E_persistence.caveat: persistence is measured only while the stale /events listing kept flagging the ticker (listing EV >= 1.5c and size >= 3), at the scan cadence; a run of one preflight lasted < one cadence.

F_settlement.note: one game; outcomes of the buckets are mutually exclusive and all props depend on the same game, so these are not independent draws -- no calibration claim

preflight_vs_candle.note: candle state is the previous minute's close, the preflight is the live book at that second
